pregunta: What are the fishing rules and season dates for Esquel, Trevelin and the Futaleufú in 2026/27?
texto:
Because official sport fishing regulations in Argentina are published annually shortly before the season starts, the exact **2026/2027 official rulebook (*Reglamento de Pesca Deportiva Continental Patagónico*) will not be formally released until October 2026**. 

However, fishing regulations in Chubut Province (Esquel, Trevelin) and National Parks follow a very consistent framework year after year. Below is the **projected schedule and standard regulations** for the 2026/2027 season based on established laws and historical patterns.

---

### 1. Projected Season Dates (2026 / 2027)

* **General Season:** **November 1, 2026 – May 1, 2027**
  * Applies to most rivers, streams, and lakes around Esquel, Trevelin, and the Argentine stretch of the Río Futaleufú.
* **Extended Season Waters:** **May 2, 2027 – May 31, 2027** (or June 30 in select lakes)
  * Select bodies of water (such as *Lago Rosario* or specific sections of lower rivers) often remain open for an extended period under strict Catch & Release.
* **Special Openings (Chinook Salmon):** **October 1 or October 15, 2026**
  * Specific rivers like the *Río Corcovado* (south of Trevelin) sometimes have early openings tailored to the spring Chinook (King) salmon run.

---

### 2. Licensing Requirements

To fish in Esquel, Trevelin, or the Futaleufú region, you need a valid Patagonian Fishing Permit. 
* **Unified Permit:** Argentina’s southern provinces (Chubut, Río Negro, Neuquén, Santa Cruz, Tierra del Fuego) and the National Parks Service share a reciprocal permit system. A single permit covers most waters.
* **Categories:** 
  * Resident / Non-resident Tourist (Daily, Weekly, or Full Season permits available).
* **Additional Stamp/Permit Requirements:** 
  * Trolling (Pesca de Arrastre) requires a specific additional endorsement.
  * Special management zones (e.g., trophy salmon rivers) may require an additional daily/seasonal fee.

---

### 3. General Fishing Rules (Chubut & Los Alerces)

#### Gear Restrictions
* **Hooks:** **Single barbless hooks** (*anzuelo simple sin rebarba*) are mandatory in almost all running waters (rivers/streams) and throughout Los Alerces National Park.
* **Methods:** Fly fishing (*Pesca con Mosca*) and Spinning/Lure fishing are permitted in most areas, but **bait fishing (natural/organic bait) is strictly prohibited** in almost all salmonid waters.
* **Fly Fishing Only Waters:** Specific classic streams (like the *Río Rivadavia*) are restricted strictly to fly fishing with barbless single hooks.

#### Catch & Release (Devolución Obligatoria)
* **Rivers and Streams:** 100% Mandatory Catch & Release is the default rule for almost all rivers and streams in the Esquel/Trevelin basin (including Río Rivadavia, Río Arrayanes, Río Percy, and Río Futaleufú).
* **Lakes:** Some lakes allow keeping a limited kill limit (usually 1 salmonid per angler per day), but Los Alerces National Park lakes generally mandate full C&R or very strict limits.

#### Biosecurity (Didymo Protocol)
* **Biosecurity Disinfection:** It is mandatory by law to clean, drain, and dry all gear (waders, boots, lines, belly boats) when moving between different water bodies to prevent the spread of the invasive micro-algae *Didymosphenia geminata* (Didymo).

---

### 4. Key Specific Waters in the Area

#### A. Río Futaleufú / Río Grande (Argentine Side)
* **Season:** Nov 1, 2026 – May 1, 2027.
* **Regulations:** Mandatory Catch & Release for all salmonids. Single barbless hook.
* *Note on Border Crossing:* If you cross the border to fish the **Chilean side of the Futaleufú River**, you must buy a separate **Chilean fishing license** (*Sernapesca*) as Argentine permits are not valid in Chile.

#### B. Los Alerces National Park (Near Esquel)
*(Includes Río Rivadavia, Río Arrayanes, Lago Futalaufquen, Lago Verde, Lago Menéndez)*
* **Regulations:** Covered under the *Anexo Parques Nacionales*. 
* **Navigation:** Engine restrictions apply. Electric motors or rowboats/pontoons only on sensitive rivers (e.g., motor boats are prohibited or strictly restricted on Río Rivadavia and Río Arrayanes).
* **C&R:** Full catch-and-release on all rivers within the park.

#### C. Río Corcovado & Río Percy (Near Trevelin)
* **Regulations:** Standard season (Nov 1 – May 1). Famous for Pacific Salmon (Chinook). Specific gear weight and hook size limits apply during the salmon run to prevent snagging.

---

### 5. How to Verify Final 2026/27 Rules

To get the exact, legally binding rulebook once it is published in **October 2026**:
1. Check the official portal: **[reglamendodepesca.org.ar](http://www.reglamentodepesca.org.ar/)** (Official site for Patagonian Sport Fishing Regulations).
2. Visit local fly shops or tourist info centers upon arrival in Esquel or Trevelin. Local guides will have the updated printed booklet (which includes maps and specific zone-by-zone restrictions).
